name: Cloudinary
description: The Cloudinary MCP servers enable you to upload, manage, transform, and analyze your media assets.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Cloudinary to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Cloudinary to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://asset-management.mcp.cloudinary.com/sse. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Cloudinary MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cloudinary lists 22 MCP tools, including upload-asset, asset-public_id-rename, download-asset, generate-archive, download-asset-backup, delete-asset, list-images, list-videos, list-files, get-asset-details, asset-update, and list-tags.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Cloudinary?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Cloudinary in design-creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Motion, MotionVid, Sleek, Streamloop MCP, and Image Generation.
Cloudinary requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Cloudinary is developed by Cloudinary. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
